# pvecli sdn info

Detail a vnet: definition, subnets and the guests attached to it.

```text
pvecli sdn info [VNET] [OPTIONS]
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `VNET` | Vnet name. |

## Options

| Option | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `-p`, `--profile VALUE` | Profile to use. |
| `--json` | Output raw JSON to stdout (no colors, no tables). |
